node.title: The frame: trace degeneracies = low-weight words of the flat's dual code P-perp
node.statement: For a flat P, a subset S of domain points has dependent traces iff P-perp (dual of the evaluation code) contains a word supported on S. Weight 1 = common root (gcd), weight 2 = twins, weight w = the general obstruction; minimal support => all coordinates nonzero => the CLOSURE property (a member vanishing on all-but-one of S vanishes on all of S). If the dual distance w* > r, ALL r-subsets of traces are in general position.
node.notes: unifies gcd-reduction (w=1) and twins (w=2) as rungs of one ladder; the syndrome machinery is already dual-code language | FLIP on replay (Codex wave 4): PROVABLE -> PROVED.
